display_rule: USD10m raised OR USD100m company valuation/deal consideration
privacy_model: Explicit allowlist; opaque private evidence; no message IDs, mail URLs, subjects, excerpts, raw notes, free-text claims or original payloads.

companies.description: Canonical company registry, including companies without linked deals.

taxonomy.description: Subsector definitions used in the snapshot.

aliases.description: Supported issuer naming aliases; subsidiaries and asset perimeters remain distinct.

events_all.description: Every retained canonical event, including historical, pending, small and undisclosed observations.

core_equity_all.description: Counting view for reviewed current-round pure equity with exact-day announcement and one preferred record per lifecycle.

core_equity_display.description: Core equity counting view restricted to the display threshold.

display_deals.description: Display view using USD10m raised OR USD100m valuation/consideration. Unknown-value cases remain in events_all.

ma_all.description: All acquisition observations and transaction stages.

ma_announcements_2026.description: One preferred acquisition record per lifecycle announced in the 2026 scope.

ma_closings_2026.description: One preferred acquisition record per lifecycle with a sourced closing date in the 2026 scope.

reviewed_deals.description: Source-supported reviewed preferred announcements without blocking flags.

sources.description: Public source links and publishers. Private evidence has opaque snapshot-scoped source IDs only.

event_sources.description: Event-to-evidence links, without email text or private summaries.

investors.description: Investor names extracted as deal metadata.

lifecycle_groups.description: Reconciliation groups. Use events_all.lifecycle_rank=1 for preferred observations.

quality_flags.description: Structured warning categories; raw private detail text is omitted.

registry_records.description: Every retained discovery-company record. A registry record is not a financing.

registry_sources.description: Source links for discovery and directory records.

company_financial_snapshots.description: Directory estimates, cumulative funding and valuation context. Never sum these as dated financing events.

company_coverage.description: Registry and financial-event coverage; zero linked events does not prove zero deals.

observations_all.description: One row per original retained event observation, projected to public financial facts. Conflicting assertions survive independently of preferred event values.

observation_reviews.description: Explicit observation dispositions with public evidence and paraphrased issue categories.

leads_all.description: Every retained discovery lead and disposition, including resolved and excluded context.

unresolved_leads.description: Pending and inaccessible leads; these are not verified transactions.

company_history_reviews.description: Actual company research queries, checked sources, dated dispositions and issuer/acquirer reference boundaries.

source_coverage.description: Source-family calendar and pagination coverage. Private Gmail searches and raw limitations are not published.

completion_counts.description: Audit outcome counts, including pending and inaccessible cases.

fx_rates.description: Sourced FX rates actually referenced by exported event conversions.

event_fx_conversions.description: Native monetary values are retained alongside explicit FX conversions.

company_search_logs.description: Logged indexed company searches; indexed URLs are not automatically claims of full article access.
